canonical_project: EMCS East Micronesia Cable System - Tarawa/Nanikai Cable Landing Station
owner: BwebwerikiNet Limited (BNL) / EMCS project (funded by Australia AIFFP, Japan, USA); NEC Corporation (contractor)
notes: Cable landing station (asset class: cable landing / interconnection anchor, NOT a datacenter). EMCS (2,250 km, Tarawa-Nauru-Kosrae-Pohnpei) landed at South Tarawa 2025-07-25 (BNL blog); NEC press release 2026-05-15 (A) announces construction completed and handover to BNL. GeoCables lists RFS expected 2026 with current operational status unconfirmed - re-check retail/ready-for-service status before marking live. First submarine cable to South Tarawa; interconnection evidence that could enable future facilities, not a datacenter itself.
